The concrete implementation is the unexported `service` struct defined in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:58`. It is constructed via `markdown.NewService()` called from `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51` in the `NewAPIV1Service()` function, which creates it with `WithTagExtension()` and `WithMentionExtension()` options. The `markdown.Service` interface is held by three components: (1) `APIV1Service` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`, (2) `RSSService` in `server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, and (3) `memopayload.Runner` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`. The APIV1Service creates and initializes the markdown service during its construction, then shares it with the other components via dependency injection.
